name: polylinker-bench
description: A truth set for plasmid operations. Every expected value is produced by an independent tool, never by Polylinker. All sequences are synthetic and redistributable.

conventions.cut_positions: 1-based index of the base immediately 3' of the nick on the top strand, as Bio.Restriction reports it
conventions.checksums: SEGUID v2 long form, including the prefix

hazard_tiers.1: silent, expensive, hard to notice at the bench
